description: A Flutter widget implementing a transfer screen allowing users to initiate a financial transfer between accounts or via IBAN. It maintains form state, interacts with provider-based state management for accounts and transfers, and handles user inputs and submission.

classes.name: TransferScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget providing a user interface for creating and submitting a new money transfer.

classes.name: _TransferScreenState
classes.description: State class managing form data, user interactions, and submission logic for TransferScreen.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes TextEditingControllers when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates user input, interacts with providers to process the transfer, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including input fields, buttons, and loading indicators based on current provider state.
